title: Bi-objective Two Phase Transportation Problem
summary: This paper discusses a bi-objective two-phase transportation problem (BTPTP) in which transportation takes place in two phases. The whole set of source-destination links is partitioned into two disjoint sets namely, Phase-I and Phase-II. The transportation among the source-destination links of Phase-II set is done only after the transportation among the source-destination links of Phase-I set is complete.
